mapper.sql:
WHERE 1 = 1
AND m.deleted = 1
AND m.deleted = 0
AND m.deleted = 1
AND m.status IN ('CANCELLED', 'CANCELED')
AND m.status = #{status}
AND COALESCE(m.report_count, 0) > 0
AND ( m.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR m.content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR m.user_id LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR requester.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )

WHERE 1 = 1 AND m.deleted = 1
AND mb.deleted = 1
AND mb.deleted = 0
AND mb.deleted = 1
AND mb.status IN ('CANCELLED', 'CANCELED')
AND mb.status = #{status}
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM report r WHERE r.target_type IN ('MATCH_BID', 'MATCH_COMMENT') AND r.target_id = CAST(mb.id AS CHAR) AND r.status = 'PENDING' )
AND ( m.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR mb.message LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR mb.lawyer_id LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR lawyer.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `match` m JOIN member requester ON m.user_id = requester.user_id

SELECT m.id AS matchId, m.user_id AS authorId, requester.name AS authorName, m.title AS title, m.content AS content, CASE WHEN m.status = 'CANCELED' THEN 'CANCELLED' ELSE m.status END AS status, m.match_type AS matchType, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM match_bid mb WHERE mb.match_id = m.id AND mb.deleted = 1 ) AS bidCount, COALESCE(m.report_count, 0) AS reportCount, m.deleted AS deleted, m.created_at AS createdAt FROM `match` m JOIN member requester ON m.user_id = requester.user_id
ORDER BY COALESCE(m.report_count, 0) DESC, m.id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM match_bid mb JOIN `match` m ON mb.match_id = m.id JOIN member lawyer ON mb.lawyer_id = lawyer.user_id

SELECT mb.id AS bidId, mb.match_id AS matchId, m.title AS matchTitle, mb.lawyer_id AS authorId, lawyer.name AS authorName, COALESCE(NULLIF(mb.message, ''), '입찰 메시지 없음') AS content, CASE WHEN mb.status = 'CANCELED' THEN 'CANCELLED' ELSE mb.status END AS status, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM report r WHERE r.target_type IN ('MATCH_BID', 'MATCH_COMMENT') AND r.target_id = CAST(mb.id AS CHAR) AND r.status = 'PENDING' ) AS reportCount, mb.deleted AS deleted, m.created_at AS createdAt FROM match_bid mb JOIN `match` m ON mb.match_id = m.id JOIN member lawyer ON mb.lawyer_id = lawyer.user_id
ORDER BY reportCount DESC, mb.id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT id AS targetId, user_id AS ownerUserId, title AS targetTitle, deleted AS deleted, status AS status, id AS matchId, title AS matchTitle FROM `match` WHERE id = #{matchId}

SELECT mb.id AS targetId, mb.lawyer_id AS ownerUserId, COALESCE(NULLIF(mb.message, ''), '입찰 메시지 없음') AS targetTitle, mb.deleted AS deleted, mb.status AS status, mb.match_id AS matchId, m.title AS matchTitle FROM match_bid mb JOIN `match` m ON mb.match_id = m.id WHERE mb.id = #{bidId}
mapper.update: UPDATE `match` SET status = 'CLOSED' WHERE id = #{matchId} AND deleted = 1 AND status NOT IN ('CLOSED', 'CANCELLED', 'CANCELED')
UPDATE `match` SET deleted = 0 WHERE id = #{matchId} AND deleted = 1
UPDATE `match` SET deleted = 1 WHERE id = #{matchId} AND deleted = 0
UPDATE match_bid SET deleted = 0 WHERE id = #{bidId} AND deleted = 1
UPDATE match_bid SET deleted = 1 WHERE id = #{bidId} AND deleted = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO member_admin_action_history ( admin_user_id, target_user_id, action_type, reason, created_at ) VALUES ( #{adminUserId}, #{targetUserId}, #{actionType}, #{reason}, NOW() )
